calculation.description: Cross-asset residual momentum over 40 sessions divided by downside residual volatility, winsorized with tanh and lagged one session. The negative IC indicates the usable portfolio direction is contrarian (reverse the signal).

validation.regime_notes: Negative aggregate IC is stable across 2024-2033; use contrarian direction. Regime IC: 2024-26 -0.190908 (113 dates), 2027-29 -0.018625 (782), 2030-32 -0.051670 (784), 2032-33 -0.057000 (406). Small cross-asset universe implies conservative interpretation.
